name: Spyre Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Spyre Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical stage biotechnology company, focuses on developing therapeutics for patients living with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and rheumatic diseases. The company develops SPY001, a humanized monoclonal immunoglobulin G1 antibody that is in phase-2 clinical stage designed to bind selectively to the a4ß7 integrin being developed for the treatment of IBD (ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease); and SPY002 and SPY072  anti-TL1A mAbs designed to bind to tumor necrosis factor-like ligand 1A (TL1A).
